desktop.notes:
• Top bar: Library / Edit tabs stay in place in both modes (Before keeps its spot next to Edit).
• Filters: Main colour is a spectrum at the end of the row with two dots under it - drag them to pick a range, drag inside it to move it (results follow live); ticks show the colours your photos have; a range with no photo takes in the nearest one; grey end = neutral; right/double-click clears. New Rating filter (5 stars, 4+ … 1+, no stars).
• Crop: with a fixed shape, dragging an edge grows the frame even when it touches the photo's side (it slides in); picking a shape in the panel keeps the frame as big as it fits instead of shrinking it near an edge.
• Sidebar: SHOOTS folds (click the title or arrow; folded at first, remembered).
• Screensaver (Publish): it shows every photo now, so new photos mark it to publish again.
• Words: when Gemma 3 needs a newer Ollama, Curish updates Ollama itself and goes on with the download. AI menu: Ollama's version + whether Gemma 3 is in, and "Set up / update words".
• Browse like Cullect: size slider in the toolbar (all the way up = the viewer, down = the grid; scrolling out at fit in the viewer returns to the grid), Ctrl + / Ctrl - / Ctrl+wheel; the size is remembered.
• Albums: drag a row to change the list's order - the others move aside; saved in the Library (albums.json "album_order") so Cullect shows the same order. A new album shows on TV, web, screensaver and wall by default (your existing albums keep their settings).
• Start from (Edit): JPG · RAW · RAW as JPG (default when the RAW's drive is connected) · AI. RAW as JPG develops the RAW and fits the camera JPEG's look to it (colour matrix + tone curve + corner brightening, worked out once and kept in the .pnfo): the camera's look with the RAW's room in highlights and shadows. Exposure, temperature and tint act on the RAW in linear light. The start shows on the photo and is saved with the edit; RAW / AI starts always save a JPG.
• Auto (measured from the photo: exposure, white balance, levels, colour - no AI) and Looks: Midday sun, Golden hour, Overcast, Low light, B&W - each starts from Auto; save your own (+), right-click to update / rename / delete / hide.
• Edit keys: K Edit <-> Library, D original <-> adjusted (button "Original"), F next start. (The earlier K / D / F for albums and stars are gone; Ctrl+B still adds to the target album.)
• AI helper (its own box, AI colour): Clean noise (SCUNet, full strength - the % slider is gone) and a Result size (same · 4K · 5K · 8K · 2× · 4× · your own number): bigger than the photo runs the upscaler (Real-ESRGAN, up to 4×). Tells you when the photo was already clean. Edit then starts from "AI"; what is saved is marked AI (badge, "ai_made" in the .pnfo). A big AI badge sits bottom right on the picture.
• Looks are toggles: Auto · Midday sun · Golden hour · Overcast · Low light · B&W · Vivid · Crisp · Soft. The one in use is lit; click again to get your earlier adjustments back; change anything by hand and the light goes out.
• Crop in Cullect's way: Free · Original · 3:2 · 4:5 · 1:1 · 16:9 and Wide / Tall (turns the frame), one line.
• Cullect's crop shows everywhere: the frame on the Library card (as in Cullect) + a crop badge; the large view and Edit open on the cropped photo, tagged "Cropped" (hold Q: the whole photo). Kept in library.json ("crop").
• Every card in Edit folds, all closed to start with; shorter texts.
• New adjustments (plain maths, no AI): Highlights, Shadows, Vibrance, Clarity, Dehaze, Sharpness.
• Metadata: the recipe stays in the photo's .pnfo (edit.recipe) with edit.v (recipe version) and edit.summary (the edit in words) - readable on any computer; nothing is burned into the original.
• New icon: a sunrise photo inside gold crop corners.
